title: OresEdgeRouterConfig
description: Per-org edge routing contract: which subdomains exist on the org's apex domain, which origin is primary (k8s-cluster) and which is the fallback (Cloud Run / CDN / GitHub), and how health is probed. This file is the single authority for the org's Cloudflare edge; wrangler.toml is rendered from it.

org.description: GitHub org (1:1 with this domain, the Linear project, the Supabase org, the Neon org and the GCP project).

domain.description: Apex domain owned by the org and served by Cloudflare.

linearProject.description: Linear project URL recording this routing implementation (AGENTS.md 1:1:1:1 convention).

gcpProject.description: GCP project id hosting the Cloud Run fallbacks.

hosts.description: Keyed by subdomain label. The canonical set is auth, org, user, api, admin, api-admin; extra labels (www, registry, web, cdn, ...) are allowed.

url.description: Scheme + host (+ optional :port) of the origin; no path.

hostHeader.description: Host header to send. Defaults to the public hostname (<label>.<domain>) so the k8s ingress can route by host.

mode.description: proxy = fetch from origin and stream back; redirect = 302 the client to the origin (for CDN/GitHub fallbacks that cannot serve arbitrary paths); unavailable = answer a controlled JSON 503 with Retry-After (url not required) so API clients keep their own retry/fallback behaviour.

pathPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to the request path at this origin (e.g. /releases/download).

paths.description: ALL paths must return 2xx for the primary to count as healthy.

failThreshold.description: Consecutive failed probes before the primary is marked down.

recoverThreshold.description: Consecutive successful probes before the primary is marked up again.

staleAfterSeconds.description: If the last probe result is older than this, treat health as unknown and fall back to per-request probing.

access.description: cloudflare-access requires a Cloudflare Access assertion header (admin/api-admin per AGENTS.md); deny returns 404 always.

retryOnPrimaryError.description: On 502/503/504/timeout from the primary, retry idempotent requests against the fallback within the same request.
